note: MCP signatures and JSON CLI operation names extracted statically. These are not native Harness signatures; descriptions are from this release, not a statement of tested compatibility on every host.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_visualization
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_visualization(action: str, arguments: dict | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Read figure reference; register existing images as preview; inspect integrity; or record visual review.

action: reference|manifest|inspect|review. No rendering, package installation, scientific
approval or project-state mutation. Review requires actual image inspection, reviewer,
observations, required image keys and checks, bound to the exact manifest_sha256.
CLI equivalents are visualization.reference/.manifest/.inspect/.review.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_sequence_stats
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_sequence_stats(inputs: list[str], output: str, paired: bool=False)
mcp_tools.description:
Inspect one/two explicit local FASTA/FASTQ files, including gzip, without a model or scientific pipeline.

Creates only statistics and execution provenance in a new output directory outside input directories.
Verifies nucleotide records, lengths/GC and optional paired FASTQ identifiers (R1,R2 order).
Bounded to 256 MiB decompressed input and 2,000,000 total records. No approval/state changes,
network, downloads, installation or scientific commands; never substitutes for a frozen analysis.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_catalog
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_catalog(action: str='list', query: str='', workflow_id: str='', limit: int=4)
mcp_tools.description: List workflow metadata, show one guide, or search curated analysis guidance; never runs tools.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_software_inspect
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_software_inspect(project: str, logical_tool: str, executable: str | None=None, software_family: str | None=None, environment_name: str | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Inspect existing environments, executable/version/help and package ownership without installation/writeback.

Keep logical capability, executable, software family and preferred environment separate.
Missing mapping is discovery work, not a reason to guess a package or install software.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_capabilities
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_capabilities(project: str | None=None)
mcp_tools.description: Read actual backend version, contracts and effective phase permissions without starting analysis.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_database
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_database(project: str, operation: str, user_message: str, message_id: str, arguments: dict | None=None, session_id: str='portable-host')
mcp_tools.description:
Discover local candidates, inspect READY records, validate evidence, or bind within approved scope.

Validation saves a receipt but never modifies the resource. Binding requires a current
dependency approval in BOOTSTRAP/PRETEST_REPAIR. Forward real user provenance; no
approval flags or arbitrary registry writes are accepted.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_project_status
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_project_status(project: str)
mcp_tools.description: Read persistent project state, approvals and report paths across host conversations.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_maintenance
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_maintenance(project: str, operation: str, user_message: str, message_id: str, arguments: dict | None=None, session_id: str='portable-host', host_events: list[dict] | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Inspect, list/read evidence, write_draft, repair_input, cleanup, export or planning_policy.

Forward the actual user request and stable message/session IDs; never invent consent.
Phase and ownership restrictions apply even with broad host permissions. Use inspect
to see supported parameters; cleanup can affect only registered task-owned artifacts.
Same request_id retries are idempotent. Drafts never imply scientific approval.
Export can include host-provided transcript events; otherwise it identifies project-only
coverage. External export destinations must be explicitly designated by the user.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_planning_recovery
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_planning_recovery(project: str)

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_resolve_input
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_resolve_input(project: str, declaration: str)
mcp_tools.description: Resolve explicit local files/manifest into a pending input proposal; never approve or download.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_resolve_derived_input
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_resolve_derived_input(project: str, parent_run_id: str, samples: list[dict], cohort_artifacts: dict | None=None)
mcp_tools.description: Propose all sample-owned outputs from a completed cohort run; never approve.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_resolve_external_cohort_input
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_resolve_external_cohort_input(project: str, local_roots: list[str], samples: list[dict], cohort_artifacts: dict, provenance: dict | None=None)
mcp_tools.description: Propose full local cohort matrices/annotations with explicit columns; never approve.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_propose_requirement
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_propose_requirement(project: str, topic: str, value: dict)
mcp_tools.description: Propose dataset, target or analysis_goal for operator review; does not confirm it.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_planning_context
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_planning_context(project: str, query: str, workflow_ids: list[str] | None=None, visualization_topics: list[str] | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Read selected full workflow guides and project evidence after requirements/input confirmation.

For each selected reference, the candidate plan must provide workflow_decisions with
workflow_id, disposition (use/adapt/not_applicable), reason and actual step_ids.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_plan
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_plan(plan: dict, project: str='', save: bool=False)
mcp_tools.description: Validate a candidate plan; optionally persist it for review after requirements are confirmed.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_dependencies
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_dependencies(project: str, review_confirmed_plan: bool=False, plan: dict | None=None)
mcp_tools.description: Preview local resources or create the dependency decision report for an already confirmed plan. No install.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_decision_review
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_decision_review(project: str, topic: str)
mcp_tools.description: Get exact material/fingerprint for an operator decision. This tool cannot approve anything.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_approval_mode
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_approval_mode(project: str, action: str='inspect', mode: str='', user_request: str='', source: str='', scope: str='', topics: list[str] | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Inspect mode or configure project delegation only at the user's explicit request.

Preserve the real user request, conversation source, scope and allowed topics.
This records a host assertion, not independent authentication. Interactive mode
uses an empty topic list and stops future delegated decisions, not existing jobs.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_record_decision
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_record_decision(project: str, topic: str, action: str, expected: str, authorization_fingerprint: str, reason: str)
mcp_tools.description:
Record a reviewed decision under explicit project delegation, retaining all scientific gates.

Read decision_review first; pass its full current fingerprint and the active
authorization fingerprint. Explain the review in reason. Never invent the user's
request or use this when project delegation is absent or outside its scope.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_job_start
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_job_start(project: str, operation: str, request_id: str, parameters: dict | None=None)
mcp_tools.description:
Start bootstrap, resolve_databases, pretest, finalize or frozen production behind existing approval gates.

Bootstrap may install only dependencies already explicitly approved in the current dependency plan.
Reuse the same request_id when retrying submission; query the returned durable job_id after disconnects.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_job_status
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_job_status(project: str, job_id: str)
mcp_tools.description: Read durable local job status and result/log paths; a dead worker is reported as interrupted.

mcp_tools.name: microbiome_job_cancel
mcp_tools.signature: microbiome_job_cancel(project: str, job_id: str)
mcp_tools.description: Cancel only the verified process group for this local job; never deletes project artifacts.
